commandsRun.cmd: cd apps/desktop && pnpm --filter desktop build >/dev/null && npx playwright test e2e/live-card-organic.spec.ts e2e/live-card-fit.spec.ts e2e/live-card-no-cover.spec.ts e2e/live-card-keeps-chat.spec.ts --reporter=line

openQuestions: No existing test assertions were changed.

Root cause of the earlier all-cards-hidden style failure found here: a registered <number> --pc-ratio makes var(--pc-ratio, 16 / 10) invalid at computed-value time, so aspect-ratio fell to auto and the stage was 0px tall; the var() fallbacks were removed and a unit assertion pins that.

Deviation from the design: the card repaints when the remembered size differs from what that card instance rendered, not only when rememberPaint reports a change, because two cards of the same lane (bots view and mission pane) share the memory.

Not exercised by any test: the canvas (live stream / web) cross-fade and FrameScreen keep path under a source change, and the HOLD_MS timer. e2e/app-preview-stream.spec.ts and e2e/browser-preview.spec.ts were not run.
The docked deck's top shift when stack depth changes stays instant (animating it can push the card past the thread floor).
